items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: So Howard Rumsey calls me to work The Lighthouse on a Sunday afternoon which entailed the whole day.

ctx.x: Did you have any connections before you got here?

No. I had one connection, Vince Guaraldi. Vince Guaraldi, I took his place with Woody Herman. He told me he said, “If you come to L.A., Frank,” he says, “you call me. Let me know.” So I did that. And at the time he was working at The Lighthouse with Frank Rosolino and Conte and Bob Cooper and Bud Shank, and I’m trying to think of all the guys. Stan Levey was there in those days and anyway, Art Pepper. So one day when I came to L.A. I found this place to live, a home, a nice place. And after I paid the rent and…
